# deed_kind (Resource)

A custom Deed kind: an entity type with a versioned JSON Schema (2020-12) for `spec`. Built-in kinds (`server`, `service`, `repository`, …) are owned by Deed and cannot be managed; read them with the `deed_kind` data source. Requires an installation `admin` (or owner) token.

Changing `schema` **publishes a new schema version** that becomes the storage version. Deed accepts a non-breaking version only when it is backward compatible with the current one and every existing entity validates; otherwise the apply fails with the compatibility problems. Set `breaking = true` and a `migration` mode to publish an incompatible schema: `revalidate` refuses the publication if any entity fails validation, `mark_invalid` publishes it and flags failing entities as invalid (they are never dropped).

Destroying a kind fails while live entities still use it; entities that are only tombstoned do not block it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "deed_kind" "ups" {
  name        = "example.com/ups"
  title       = "UPS"
  description = "Uninterruptible power supply."
  icon        = "tabler:battery-charging"
  color       = "#2f9e44"

  # Reports of a UPS with a known serial number converge on the same entity.
  identity_keys = [["/spec/serial"]]

  # JSON Schema (2020-12) for spec. Changing it publishes a new schema version.
  schema = jsonencode({
    type                 = "object"
    additionalProperties = false
    required             = ["capacity_va"]
    properties = {
      capacity_va = { type = "integer", minimum = 0 }
      serial      = { type = "string" }
      model       = { type = "string" }
    }
  })

  # Publish incompatible schema changes as breaking versions that flag failing entities instead of refusing them.
  # breaking  = true
  # migration = "mark_invalid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Kind name: a lowercase identifier, optionally prefixed by a domain (`example.com/ups`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `title` (String) Singular display name, e.g. `UPS`.

### Optional

- `breaking` (Boolean) Publish `schema` changes as a breaking version (default `false`). Requires `migration`. Only used when `schema` changes; it is not read back from Deed.
- `color` (String) Color as `#rrggbb`.
- `deprecated` (Boolean) Mark the kind deprecated (default `false`).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `group` (String) Catalog group the kind is listed under (default `custom`).
- `icon` (String) Icon as `pack:name` with pack `tabler`, `simple-icons`, `thesvg` or `custom`, e.g. `tabler:battery`.
- `identity_keys` (List of List of String) Identity keys: each key is a list of 1–4 JSON pointers (`/spec/…` or `/metadata/…`). Sources that report an entity whose key values match exactly one existing entity converge on it instead of creating a duplicate.
- `migration` (String) Migration mode of a breaking publication: `revalidate` (refuse when an existing entity fails) or `mark_invalid` (flag failing entities). Only used when `schema` changes with `breaking = true`.
- `plural` (String) Plural display name. Defaults to `title` followed by `s`.
- `schema` (String) JSON Schema (2020-12) for `spec`, as a JSON string (use `jsonencode`). Defaults to an open object. Compared semantically, so Deed's re-encoding (sorted keys, compact) never causes a diff. A semantic change publishes a new version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The kind name.
- `storage_version` (String) Current storage (schema) version, e.g. `v2`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_kind.ups example.com/ups # kind name
```
